text:
Ilana (People Ops): Quick thought 1-min micro-kudos kiosk next Wed 11:30-1pm in the atrium. People can drop a 1-line shoutout on a postcard and grab a sticker token. Want to include remote folks by mailing a tiny kit. Thoughts? :sparkles:
Marcus (HR): Love it. Need to confirm swag vs spot-award rules if managers later ask for cash conversions. I'll check thresholds and reply by EOD.
Eli - Eng: Mail kits sound great. What's the per-kit budget? Shipping to some states can get pricey.
Ilana (People Ops): Target <$8/kit (sticker, postcard, packing). If shipping exceeds that we can offer a digital kudos badge + small e-gift.
Noor - CS: Can we make the postcard form short? Customer-facing teams love quick, anonymous notes. Anonymity please.
Ilana (People Ops): Yes optional anonymity. Form fields: nominee, 1-line reason (max 120 chars), remote checkbox. We'll also leave cards on the kiosk for on-site notes.
Olive (Facilities): I'll reserve the atrium table and request two standing easels for signs. Need final headcount by Monday for kit prep.
Ilana (People Ops): Volunteer slots: 11:15-11:30 setup, 11:30-12:15 host, 12:15-1:00 host/teardown. Who can take hosting?
Eli - Eng: I can do 12:15-1:00 teardown.
Noor - CS: I'll do 11:30-12:15 hosting. Happy to help print postcards.
Marcus (HR): Quick policy note: If a token converts to a cash spot-award, manager needs to submit the spot-award form and note the original kiosk nomination. I'll post the link to the form.
kudos-bot: Auto: "Sam nominated Priya for helping rewrite the onboarding cheat-sheet! :tada:"
Ilana (People Ops): Nice. Action items: Ilana to draft announcement + form by Thu, Olive to confirm table by Mon, Marcus to confirm policy by EOD, Noor to mock postcard design by Fri. We'll also prepare a small CSV to record mailed kits for audit.
Noor - CS: I'll include a QR code on the poster linking to the form and a tiny example sentence people can copy.
Ilana (People Ops): Perfect. Keeping it low-key and quick. Final ask: anyone who wants to help pack kits on Tue 4pm?
Eli - Eng: I can help pack kits Tue 4pm.
Olive (Facilities): I'll handle pickup of stickers and postcards Wed morning.
Ilana (People Ops): Thanks team! I'll post the announcement tomorrow morning.
notes: micro-kudos kiosk, remote kit mailing, volunteer shifts, HR to confirm spot-award conversion policy, QR form + postcards
